# Real Estate Business

> > Australia's leading source of news, insights, and professional development for real estate agents, property managers, and industry professionals.

Real Estate Business covers the Australian property industry with market intelligence, career guidance, business strategies, and profiles of top agents and coaches. The site features expert commentary from industry leaders including Tom Panos, Shane Smollen, and representatives from major agencies like Ray White, McGrath, and L.J Hooker.

## Key Topics

- Real estate agents
- Property management
- Australian property market
- Real estate coaching and training
- Business development and growth
- Top agents and industry leaders
- Sales strategies and techniques
- Marketing and customer service
- Sydney and Melbourne markets
- Agency culture and wellbeing
- Industry events (AREC)
- Rent roll management
- Social media marketing
- Property industry commentary

## Getting Started

- [Real Estate Business - News for real estate professionals](https://www.realestatebusiness.com.au/): Homepage for Australia's leading real estate news and market intelligence

- [Working as a real estate agent: Pros and cons](https://www.realestatebusiness.com.au/industry/22211-working-as-a-real-estate-agent-pros-and-cons): Career guide by Zarah Torrazo on pros/cons of real estate agent profession
- [Build a culture of wellbeing and produce great results](https://www.realestatebusiness.com.au/industry/10734-build-a-culture-of-wellbeing-and-produce-great-results): Ray White Robina's Scott Burgess on workplace wellbeing & business success
